about: The five founder questions of WP-4 (t1-t5) with the seed records a correct answer rests on, judged by meaning and written before the dry run, plus three paraphrase probes (p1-p3) worded without the seed's vocabulary. t1-t5 share words with the seed because one author wrote both: their recall is an optimistic upper bound.
